Privacy notice

This notice describes the information collected by the property enquiry forms on ramrealty.in and how those enquiries are handled.

What you may share

All project forms ask for your name and phone number, include the property name and a required consent checkbox, and contain a hidden anti-spam field. The MVV-GV Grand form also asks for a budget range, preferred area and buying timeline. The Vaisakhi West Winds, Utkarsha Capital Towers and A Square Maple Woods forms ask for a preferred layout and offer an optional buying timeline. Please do not submit financial account numbers or identity documents.

How the information is used

Ram Realty uses the submitted details to respond to the property enquiry and, if requested, arrange a callback or site visit. Netlify Forms processes the submissions and makes them available to the Ram Realty site owner in the Netlify dashboard. The three project forms named above may also attach the URL campaign values utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content and utm_term. When present, these values are kept in browser session storage for the tab and may be attached to a later enquiry. The MVV-GV Grand form does not collect those campaign/referrer fields.

Sharing and retention

Your enquiry details should be accessed only by people handling your request and service providers needed to operate the website and form. They are not intended for unrelated marketing or public display. Netlify may process submission data under its own service terms and settings. Ram Realty should remove enquiries when they are no longer needed for the enquiry or applicable record-keeping.

Your choices

You can choose not to submit the form and contact Ram Realty directly by phone or WhatsApp. To request access, correction, or deletion of an enquiry, call or WhatsApp +91 77992 51808 and identify the enquiry and phone number used.

The current site pages do not include analytics or advertising pixels. This notice should be updated if the forms or other data collection change.
